# skills-marketplace

A [Claude Code plugin marketplace](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/plugins).
Add it on claude.ai under **Customize -> Plugins -> Add marketplace** as
`jeffreyclegg/skills-marketplace`, or in Claude Code with
`/plugin marketplace add jeffreyclegg/skills-marketplace`.

**Generated - do not edit.** Every file here is a build artifact of a
private source repo and is replaced wholesale on each deploy. Issues and
PRs against this repo will be overwritten.

## Contents

5 plugins of vendored, pinned upstream skills. Each plugin is an
unmodified-or-remixed copy of the upstream below, pinned to the commit shown;
licenses are the upstreams' own.

| Plugin | Upstream | Pin | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `anthropic` | https://github.com/anthropics/skills | `34040c9c5685` | See upstream |
| `azure` | https://github.com/microsoft/azure-skills | `f8fac821eca9` | MIT |
| `mattpocock` | https://github.com/mattpocock/skills | `c55ee46073ed` | MIT |
| `mitsuhiko` | https://github.com/mitsuhiko/agent-stuff | `122e2994addd` | See upstream |
| `ponytail` | https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail | `e3ba2aa6f1e6` | See upstream |
